market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain volatile and risk-off. Bond rout and oil spike create headwinds for equities. Hormuz/Iran headlines drive intraday swings. US-China trade truce extension provides floor. Expect S&P 500 to trade in tight range with elevated VIX. Energy and defense outperform; growth and rate-sensitive sectors lag. Watch for Fed commentary on inflation path.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally positive but faces valuation digestion. Energy transition (EU rules, renewables) creates winners/losers. Rising rate environment normalizes but geopolitical risk premium persists. US-China trade truce buys time but structural decoupling continues. Consumer bifurcation (luxury vs. value) persists through 2027. Defense spending cycle multi-year positive.
